conviction_note: Nothing material the market has not seen: the Q3 bar (ABG commissioned preview, sales 228 / EBIT 43 MSEK) is public and the stock has already fallen about 13% since that preview, every Q3 order (114 MSEK) was announced, and the company's own backlog-recognition note implies an H2 total close to ABG's. findings.finding: The bar was reset down before the print and the price has moved more than the estimates. ABG's 29 Sep preview cut 2026e EBIT 10.7% and forecast a sequential sales decline. The stock fell 6.2% on 30 Sep, the day it was republished, and is down about 13% from 37.54 SEK (28 Sep) to 32.58 SEK (20 Oct), so a 'lukewarm' Q3 is in the price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Report days (Yahoo closes on the issuer's actual release dates): Q3'25 31 Oct 2025 gapped +11% and closed -7.0% on zero order intake; Q4'25 19 Feb 2026 +12.0%; Q1'26 23 Apr 2026 -6.1%; Q2'26 17 Jul 2026 -2.3% after an EBIT miss that ABG had expected to cost about 5%
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. That is the finding's whole content, and it agrees with the run-up lean (-13.6% over 20 days), so it is sized small. If the market had NOT absorbed the cut, the price would still be near the 37-38 SEK it held through September.

findings.finding: The company's own backlog note says 71% of the 668 MSEK order book (about 474 MSEK) is recognised in H2 2026. With about 114 MSEK of Q3 orders announced since, partly delivering in H2, H2 revenue comes to roughly 520-550 MSEK, against ABG's implied H2 of 516 MSEK (1,021 FY - 505 H1). That is a slight upside to the H2 total, but it does not settle how Q3 and Q4 split.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales were in line in Q2'26 (245 vs 246 cons) and the stock moved -2.3% on margins. Revenue beats in Q4'25 coincided with +12%.
findings.why_not_priced: The backlog note sits on page 17 of the PDF and ABG's own model is close to it in total. The only unpriced part is how H2 is phased between Q3 and Q4, which nobody outside the company knows. If it were priced as a beat, the stock would not be sitting at the post-cut low.
findings.independence: ABG FY26e 1,021 MSEK: https://cr.abgsc.com/contentassets/652b4808dba34dc0b2b0ad033af2743f/pdf/lukewarm-q3-on-the-cards.pdf (agrees on the H2 total and puts more of it in Q4)

findings.finding: The order book will print lower. About 114 MSEK of announced Q3 intake against roughly 230 MSEK of Q3 revenue takes the book from 668 to about 550 MSEK, the fourth straight quarterly fall (1,159 -> 1,017 -> 1,025 -> 806 -> 668). The FMV 24-month SATCOM service that carries most of the revenue started June 2025, so it runs to about May 2027, and 2027 visibility shrinks.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25: zero new orders and a falling book took the stock from +11% at the open to -7.0% at the close. Q1'26: order intake of 12 MSEK, -6.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is arithmetically derivable from announced orders, so it is mostly priced. The residual is that the printed order-book number lands as a headline on the morning, and this name has sold off on order-book headlines twice in four reports.
findings.independence: FMV contract duration (24 months from June 2025): https://www.satnow.com/news/details/3388-ovzon-receives-1-04-billion-order-from-the-swedish-defence-materiel-administration-fmv-

outside_window.finding: The European NATO 74 MSEK SATCOM renewal runs five months from 1 Aug 2026, so it expires about end-December. The next renewal, and any 'coalition' expansion, is a Q4/Q1 event.
The remaining 56 MSEK of the US government order is booked only once federal funding is processed, which is a later quarter.
The FMV two-year SATCOM service (about 80% of the 1,038 MSEK order) ends around May 2027, which is the 2027 renewal cliff.
